SELECT store_id, record_path FROM stores WHERE city = 'Graz';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.available_today_quantity), 0) AS total FROM stores s LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON s.store_id = si.store_id AND si.product_sku = (SELECT pv.product_sku FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_kinds pk ON pv.product_kind_id = pk.product_kind_id JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp1 ON pv.product_sku = pvp1.product_sku AND pvp1.property_key = 'color_family' AND pvp1.property_value_text = 'White' JOIN product_variant_properties pvp2 ON pv.product_sku = pvp2.product_sku AND pvp2.property_key = 'finish' AND pvp2.property_value_text = 'matte' WHERE pv.brand = 'Helios' AND pk.product_kind_name = 'Wall Paint' AND pf.product_family_name = 'Helios Interior Belton 1VS-ZMH Wall Paint') WHERE s.city = 'Graz';
